text: Logan, Utah, 2011. A motorcycle hit a car, and *both caught fire.* The rider, 21-year-old Brandon Wright, was trapped underneath. Nobody waited for help. Students, construction workers and a police officer grabbed the burning car and *lifted it together.* One man crawled under and pulled him out. Brandon survived. *Strangers did that.* Hit like if you'd have run to help.
title: Strangers Lifted a Burning Car 🔥🤝
pinned: Would you have run toward the fire? 👇
